messages:
kevin: Quick sync: rolling out auto-fallbacks (cascade-v3). I want the console to make the reason obvious without dumping request text. Ideas? :zap:

maria: Console should show a short reason + one-line evidence (metric snapshot). e.g. 'latency p95 1200ms -> fallback to quiet-degrade'.

sam: Agreed. Also we need a single-click 'open forensics' that leads to the audited trace in the log-store. Console = triage; audit = deep dive.

lucy: For audit events we must avoid raw inputs. Store: hashed_prefix, token_count, redaction_flag, and a boolean sampled_snippet_allowed. That keeps legal teams happy.

kevin: UI pattern: compact row in table with pill: [WARN] Quiet Degrade • reason: latency_tail • est_cost: +8% • view. Click opens side panel with 3 panels: metrics, policy excerpt, audit link.

maria: Telemetry we should emit per decision (flat keys): decision_id, trigger, policy, rule_id, severity, p95_ms, error_rate_pct, sample_pct, org_hash, override_by. No nested objects.

sam: API: GET /v1/fallbacks/decision?id=<id> -> returns flat record. Keep field names snake_case for backwards compat. e.g., decision_id, ts, trigger, policy_name, p95_ms, err_pct, sample_rate.

lucy: Operator overrides: temp (TTL) and permanent. Temp default 10m (configurable). Temp shows a countdown and user who applied it. Permanent requires ticket id + approver.

ops-bot: notice: fallback_rate(service-payments) = 3.1% over 5m -> alerting channel.

kevin: UX microcopy suggestion: 'Routed to Quiet Degrade due to sustained p95 latency spike (see audit for details)'. Keep it neutral.

maria: Small addition: show 'sampled: yes/no' in side panel with a link to request redaction review if needed.

sam: Enum list for triggers we agreed: latency_tail, backend_errors, qos_violation, quota_exhausted, safety_flag. Document in API doc.

kevin: Action items: sam -> PR for API shape (flat response); lucy -> update telemetry schema in infra-telemetry; maria -> figma card prototype. I'll draft a short RFC for retention (default 90d).

lucy: note: decide on decision_id format: include org_hash prefix to avoid cross-org collisions. e.g., "orgabc-aid-1799007777-1".

kevin: sweet. if no objections i'll spin this into a draft RFC and attach the mock. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
